title: Show an empty-list message
summary: A useful list explains when it has no items.
introduction: A useful list explains when it has no items. Your task: Write an empty message for a garden task list.
learningObjectives: Write an empty message for a garden task list.

blocks.text: A useful list explains when it has no items. FlatList can render a dedicated empty component.
Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.

blocks.code:
import {FlatList,Text} from "react-native";
export default function App(){return <FlatList data={[]} renderItem={({item})=><Text>{item.title}</Text>} ListEmptyComponent={<Text>Add your first book to begin.</Text>} contentContainerStyle={{padding:24}}/>;}

items: `FlatList` uses `data`, `renderItem` and stable item keys to display a potentially large native list.

blocks.text: The empty list shows a helpful next step instead of a blank screen.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: An empty list and a failed load are different states. Give each an accurate message in a real app.
